$comment: Single source of truth for the roadmap. tools/gen_roadmap.py renders ROADMAP.md and the tracking page from this file. Update 'status' and 'done' here, never in the generated outputs.
premise: Show how the gap between human and machine cognition has moved over time, as a graph of the research itself.

decisions.a: A progress view. Nodes are paper clusters, or individual papers where the paper is major.
Yes. An eval harness re-runs instruments on current models so convergence is measured, not only cited.
Semi-automated ingestion with a human review gate.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.goal: A defensible taxonomy and a settled visual language to build against.

milestones.t: 28-construct taxonomy with an explicit convergence/robustness rubric
61-source seed bibliography, every entry real and linkable
7 paired protocols where humans and models both report a number
Dala design system applied across six plates

phases.name: Data model v2 - papers as nodes
phases.goal: The graph renders from real papers with real dates, so a time axis becomes possible.

milestones.t: Schema for paper, cluster, edge and measurement records
Migrate the 61 sources into paper records: year, domain, citations, axis tags
Demote the 28 constructs from nodes to taxonomy that tags and scores papers
Three edge kinds: lineage, correspondence, contradiction
Referential-integrity validator wired into a pre-commit check

phases.exit: Every source is a node with a year, and the validator passes clean.

phases.name: Ingestion pipeline
phases.goal: Grow the corpus without hand-typing every record, and without letting quality slip.

milestones.t: OpenAlex adapter for metadata, citations and reference edges
Discovery queries per axis, deduplicated against the existing corpus
Review CLI: accept, reject, tag an axis, mark major, assign a cluster
Cluster proposals from the citation graph, confirmed by hand
Provenance on every record: how it entered and who accepted it

phases.exit: 300-500 papers in the corpus, resolving to roughly 60-80 visible nodes.

phases.name: The atlas

milestones.t: Static site, no backend: data ships as JSON beside the page
Force graph, two constellations, correspondence and contradiction edges
Time scrubber: drag a year, watch the corpus and the gap move
Cluster nodes expand to their member papers
Per-node panel with findings and sources
The six plates as the scrolling argument around the graph

phases.exit: Deployed, readable on a phone, and the time scrubber tells the story without narration.

phases.name: Eval harness
phases.goal: Stop being downstream of other people's methods.

milestones.t: Instruments as data: prompt templates, scoring, and perturbation variants
Runner that records measurement rows against named models and dates
Perturbation suite as a first-class citizen, so robustness is measured not coded
Measured results sit beside cited ones in the same schema
Re-run on a schedule as new models ship

phases.exit: At least eight axes carry a measured convergence and robustness number we produced ourselves.

phases.name: Progress over time
phases.goal: The headline the project exists to show.

milestones.t: Axis scores as time series, combining cited history and our own runs
Convergence and robustness plotted against year
Comparison across model generations on identical instruments
Honest uncertainty bands - thin evidence must look thin

phases.exit: One chart answers 'is the gap closing, and in what' without a caption.

phases.name: The argument
phases.goal: Land the reading, with the evidence behind it.

milestones.t: Closing argument rewritten against the time-series evidence
Method write-up: rubric, coding procedure, known weaknesses
Public launch

phases.exit: A reader who disagrees can find exactly which coding to attack.

invariants: Never invent a number. Every figure traces to a cited paper or to a measurement row we produced.
Codings are not findings. Convergence and robustness are our judgements against the rubric; label them that way everywhere.
Contradictions stay visible. Where the literature disputes itself, the graph shows the dispute rather than averaging it away.
Robustness outranks convergence. A match that dies under rewording is the finding, not a footnote.
The design system is settled. Dala, per docs/DESIGN.md. Do not redesign it.
